raw: {"vulnerable": true, "class": "Missing sysvar account verification (fake instructions sysvar / signature check bypass)", "why": "The `instruction_acc` account is never checked to be the real `sysvar::instructions` account and the deprecated `load_instruction_at`/`load_current_index` perform no address check, so an attacker can supply a forged account containing a fabricated secp256k1 instruction and mark guardian signatures as verified without any real signatures (the Wormhole exploit)."}

{"vulnerable": false, "class": "", "why": "This is the patched Wormhole verify_signatures: it uses load_current_index_checked/load_instruction_at_checked which validate the instructions sysvar account, checks the secp program id, enforces per-entry instruction indices and message consistency, and remaining edge cases (e.g. off-by-one index) only cause a panic rather than an exploit."}
